proposed_claim: Cumulative-threshold XGBoost achieved the highest full-OOF macro-F1, 0.6255.
evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
mandatory_qualifier: Highest applies only to macro-F1 among the nine evaluated systems.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not generalize this ranking to every metric or future population.

proposed_claim: Cumulative-threshold XGBoost achieved the highest full-OOF balanced accuracy, 0.6745.
evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
mandatory_qualifier: Highest applies only to balanced accuracy among the nine evaluated systems.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim universal or statistically significant superiority.

proposed_claim: Random Forest had the highest full-OOF quadratic weighted kappa, 0.6317.
evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
mandatory_qualifier: The ordering criterion is QWK, not macro-F1 or probability quality.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call Random Forest the universally best model.

proposed_claim: Random Forest had the lowest full-OOF ordinal MAE, 0.1583.
evidence_scope: Full exactly-once OOF INX sample under the frozen P3 protocol.
mandatory_qualifier: Lower is better, and this result does not determine other metric rankings.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not equate low ordinal MAE with complete error safety.

proposed_claim: LightGBM had the lowest normalized ranked probability score, 0.0804.
evidence_scope: Raw full-OOF probabilities from nine systems under the P3 protocol.
mandatory_qualifier: Lower is better and the claim applies to normalized RPS only.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer overall model superiority from one probability metric.

proposed_claim: Nominal XGBoost had the lowest raw log loss, 0.5515.
evidence_scope: Raw full-OOF probabilities from nine systems under the P3 protocol.
mandatory_qualifier: Lower is better and the comparison precedes the predeclared sigmoid evaluation.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present raw log-loss leadership as universal superiority.

proposed_claim: Across five repeated nested-CV designs, XGBoost mean macro-F1 was 0.6288.
evidence_scope: Mean over five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions.
mandatory_qualifier: The mean is descriptive across five repetitions and is not a confidence estimate.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim stable universal leadership or population-level certainty.

proposed_claim: Across five repeated nested-CV designs, LightGBM mean macro-F1 was 0.6249.
evidence_scope: Mean over five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions.
mandatory_qualifier: LightGBM and XGBoost split repetition-level macro-F1 wins.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer a significant difference from the two descriptive means.

proposed_claim: Random Forest ranked first for QWK in 5 of 5 repetitions.
evidence_scope: Winner count over five prespecified nested-CV repetitions.
mandatory_qualifier: The stable winner statement applies only to QWK under this design.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer universal superiority or prospective stability.

proposed_claim: Cumulative-threshold XGBoost ranked first for balanced accuracy in 4 of 5 repetitions.
evidence_scope: Winner count over five prespecified nested-CV repetitions.
mandatory_qualifier: One repetition was won by another model and no inferential test is attached.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not describe the ordering as invariant or statistically proven.

proposed_claim: Mean pairwise macro-F1 rank Spearman correlation across repetition pairs was 0.926.
evidence_scope: Ten pairwise rank comparisons across five repetitions and six tuned models.
mandatory_qualifier: Correlations are descriptive and repetition pairs are not independent samples.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not label the ordering perfectly stable or confidence-bounded.

proposed_claim: For P2, independent retuning changed macro-F1 by +0.0185 relative to the fixed schedule.
evidence_scope: Full-OOF retuned-minus-fixed point difference for the P2 policy.
mandatory_qualifier: This point difference has no confidence interval and combines policy-specific selection with access.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the difference causal, significant, or deployment-valid.

proposed_claim: For P5, independent retuning changed QWK by -0.0344 despite improving some other metrics.
evidence_scope: Full-OOF retuned-minus-fixed point difference for the P5 policy.
mandatory_qualifier: P5 removes declared strong proxies but cannot prove absence of residual proxies.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim monotonic benefit, fairness proof, or causal proxy removal.

proposed_claim: The retuned P0 information-rich diagnostic reached macro-F1 0.8943.
evidence_scope: Retuned P0 full-OOF point estimate with outcome-proximal/timing-risk fields retained.
mandatory_qualifier: P0 is a diagnostic upper bound and is explicitly never deployable.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not present P0 as prospective performance or an admissible HR policy.

proposed_claim: The mean top-5 Jaccard agreement across model-seed pairs was 1.0000.
evidence_scope: Fifteen pairwise comparisons across fixed model seeds.
mandatory_qualifier: Pairs share data and protocol components and are not independent observations.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call SHAP perfectly robust, causal, or confidence-bounded.

proposed_claim: Mean all-feature Spearman agreement across outer-training resample pairs was 0.9847.
evidence_scope: Ten pairwise comparisons among five stratified 80% outer-training resamples.
mandatory_qualifier: The same Spearman summary is repeated across top-k rows and is descriptive.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer sampling independence or explanation validity from rank agreement alone.

proposed_claim: Deleting the top-ranked feature produced a mean probability-drop contrast of 0.2676 versus random deletion.
evidence_scope: SHAP-guided minus 20 random-repetition mean deletion contrast.
mandatory_qualifier: The contrast is descriptive and median/mode masking can be out of distribution.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not interpret the perturbation as a causal or actionable employee effect.

proposed_claim: Cross-fitted sigmoid calibration reduced log loss to 0.4556.
evidence_scope: Predeclared outer-training-only sigmoid probabilities on 1,200 exactly-once OOF cases.
mandatory_qualifier: The method was predeclared and outer-test outcomes were evaluation-only.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim prospective calibration or objective outcome probabilities.

proposed_claim: Top-label ECE changed by +0.0044 after sigmoid calibration, indicating a worse point estimate on that metric.
evidence_scope: Sigmoid-minus-raw top-label ECE difference using ten fixed bins.
mandatory_qualifier: The paired interval spans zero and ECE is bin-dependent.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not state that every calibration metric improved.

proposed_claim: Removing JobRole and refitting changed the argmax prediction for 10.75% of cases.
evidence_scope: Exact paired OOF comparison of P3 and P3 refitted without JobRole.
mandatory_qualifier: The comparison combines feature removal with refitting and is not the broader P5 policy.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not describe the change rate as a causal JobRole effect.

proposed_claim: The proxy-reduced-minus-primary macro-F1 difference was -0.0330.
evidence_scope: Exact paired OOF P3-minus-JobRole refit comparison on 1,200 cases.
mandatory_qualifier: The point difference is descriptive and combines removal with model refitting.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer discrimination, causality, or significance.

proposed_claim: Marginal within-fold JobRole permutation produced mean total variation 0.1024.
evidence_scope: Mean over 20 prespecified outcome-blind marginal shuffles.
mandatory_qualifier: Marginal shuffling can create out-of-distribution feature combinations.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat the perturbation as a causal or inferential effect.

proposed_claim: Department-conditional within-fold JobRole permutation produced mean total variation 0.0529.
evidence_scope: Mean over 20 prespecified outcome-blind department-conditional shuffles.
mandatory_qualifier: Conditioning only on department is not a fully conditional permutation test.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the difference a causal JobRole contribution.

proposed_claim: Department reconstruction accuracy with JobRole in the feature space was 0.9792.
evidence_scope: Separate nominal multiclass proxy reconstruction diagnostic.
mandatory_qualifier: This measures information in the feature space, not use by the performance model.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer discrimination, causality, or performance-model dependence.

proposed_claim: Department reconstruction accuracy without JobRole was 0.2908.
evidence_scope: Separate nominal multiclass proxy reconstruction diagnostic without JobRole.
mandatory_qualifier: This is a proxy-risk contrast, not a fairness or causal test.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer absence of residual department information or legal compliance.

proposed_claim: Under the retained three-class HRDataset_v14 mapping, raw XGBoost mean macro-F1 was 0.6531.
evidence_scope: Mean across five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions on 311 records.
mandatory_qualifier: The value is mapping- and dataset-specific and the repetition range is not a confidence interval.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not call the result locked external validation or direct INX comparability.

proposed_claim: Under the retained three-class mapping, sigmoid-calibrated XGBoost mean QWK was 0.6044.
evidence_scope: Mean across five prespecified 5×5 nested-CV repetitions on 311 records.
mandatory_qualifier: Sigmoid calibration lowered macro-F1 even while improving this ordinal criterion.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim that calibration uniformly improved HRDataset_v14 performance.

proposed_claim: The retained mapped HRDataset_v14 class 2 contains 31 records.
evidence_scope: Governed three-class target mapping combining PIP and Needs Improvement.
mandatory_qualifier: The mapping is a study estimand and does not establish equivalence with INX labels.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not treat mapped classes as validated construct-equivalent outcomes.

proposed_claim: The audited INX table contains 1200 rows.
evidence_scope: Exact pinned INX raw-table dimensions in the aggregate quality audit.
mandatory_qualifier: Row count does not establish representativeness, authenticity, or licensing.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not infer population coverage or source authority from table size.

proposed_claim: HRDataset_v14 contains 215 effective missing cells under the declared audit rule.
evidence_scope: Whitespace-aware aggregate missingness audit on the pinned 311×36 raw table.
mandatory_qualifier: Most missing termination dates are structurally aligned with non-terminated records.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not state that all missingness is error or silently impute source values.

proposed_claim: A total of 3 declared HRDataset_v14 data-quality rules had findings.
evidence_scope: Twenty-nine predeclared HRDataset_v14 audit rules.
mandatory_qualifier: The count applies to declared rules and is not a complete error census.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not claim the dataset is otherwise error-free or invalid.

proposed_claim: Those three HRDataset_v14 rules account for 6 recorded anomaly occurrences.
evidence_scope: Two occurrences in each of three declared consistency/temporal rules.
mandatory_qualifier: Occurrences can concern distinct rules and were retained without silent source repair.
prohibited_overclaim: Do not imply six unique erroneous employees without row-level overlap analysis.
